expectations.text: Recommends a custom method (not standard create/update)
expectations.evidence: Section 'Why a custom :suspend method instead of update' walks AIP-130 priority order

expectations.text: Path is scoped under the User resource (orgs/{org}/users/{user} or users/{user})
Input is minimal (just the resource name/path params, no resource body)
expectations.evidence: SuspendUserInput has organization, user, reason?, notify?, etag? — no full User body

expectations.text: Output returns the updated User resource (not void / not an Operation for a sync action)
Explanation cites AIP-130 (or general reasoning about standard vs custom methods)
expectations.evidence: Cites AIP-130, AIP-121, AIP-122, AIP-126 throughout

expectations.text: Verb is camelCase imperative (suspend, suspendUser, or similar — not snake_case or kebab-case)
